Steak,” which quickly serves heat-cooked dishes such as steak, generally regarded as high-end cuisine, at affordable prices, through company-operated stores, franchises and consignment stores. It also offers the “Niku Mileage” program, which provides benefits according to the number of visits, as well as takeout and delivery services.
